meta.label: Median age and indice di vecchiaia (2019)
meta.methodNote: Median age and indice di vecchiaia (population aged 65+ divided by population aged 0-14, x100), from ISTAT's intercensal population reconstruction. Its last year, 2019, is the most recent ISTAT publishes a comune-level age breakdown for — the live population dataflow has no age dimension at comune level (confirmed live).
